body:
## Pull request overview

This PR integrates two high-value features from `@object-ui/layout` into Console: navigation search filtering and badge indicators on navigation items. These are P0 priority items from issue #702's integration evaluation, providing immediate UX improvements with minimal risk.

**Changes:**
- Added navigation search using `filterNavigationItems` from `@object-ui/layout` with a `SidebarInput` component
- Integrated badge rendering on navigation items (both internal links and external URLs) matching the exact pattern from `NavigationRenderer`
- Added 8 comprehensive tests covering search filtering (basic, group filtering, clear, no-match) and badge rendering (numeric, text, absence)

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx | Adds search state management, `SidebarInput` with search icon, `filterNavigationItems` integration, and badge rendering in `NavigationItemRenderer` for both external and internal links |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/AppSidebar.test.tsx | New test file with 8 tests covering navigation search filtering (query, group, clear, no-match) and badge indicators (numeric, text, absence) |
| ROADMAP.md | Updates P1.7 section with two completed Console integration items |
